claim: For AWS resources that you can create alias records for, you should not create Amazon Route 53 health checks; you set Evaluate Target Health to Yes on the alias record instead.
question: How do you health check an AWS resource that has an alias record in a failover setup?

values.display: set Evaluate Target Health to Yes

qualifiers.scope: Amazon Route 53 failover configuration with alias records
qualifiers.condition: The resource is an AWS resource for which you can create alias records.

evidence.quote: If you're routing traffic to any AWS resources that you can create alias records for, don't create health checks for those resources. When you create the alias records, you set Evaluate Target Health to Yes instead.

note: d13-104. Callvale stage 4: primary alias to the ALB with Evaluate Target Health.
